steps.title: Cold key-on: read the RFHUB first
steps.why: Before any other traffic, so a B1040-64 appearing is caught and not caused by our own reads.
steps.preconditions: Car cold, key on, nothing else on the bus yet.

steps.title: EVAP: readiness, Mode 06 3A/3C, Mode 0A permanent codes
steps.why: Only useful after an overnight cold soak with fuel below 85 %; do not clear anything.
steps.preconditions: Overnight cold soak, fuel below 85 % (was 88.6 %, note 7ada5cfedef3).

steps.title: Shudder: Mode 06 misfire counters A1-A5
steps.why: Read them right after the symptom has been provoked.

steps.title: Service-value discovery, read-only
steps.why: Find which DIDs hold the service values; record the candidates, change nothing.
steps.preconditions: MES closed; engine off or idling.

steps.title: G003A ground: voltage drop, then wiggle test
steps.why: Measure stud/terminal to battery negative running, then with rear heater and blower on; photos before cleaning, then after.
steps.preconditions: Engine running; take photos BEFORE cleaning.

steps.title: Battery: read the label; in MES only read PROXI byte 63
steps.why: Record H7/H8, Ah and CCA from the label; no registration write.
steps.preconditions: Battery label visible; MES in read-only mode.

steps.title: Confirm decodings at a different load
steps.why: Compare 195B, 1925, 1926, 1009, 1959 with MES live values at a second load point.
steps.preconditions: Engine running at a load different from the first check.
steps.source: CUORE note ce54db3f26e5 and the 2026-10-26 cross-check findings

steps.title: CAN captures A, B and C with live rpm and speed
steps.why: Validates the opendbc signal decodings against this car.
steps.preconditions: Live rpm and speed visible while capturing.
